vendored.from: the agent space's own telemetry pack, kept in its private repository
vendored.kept: rule, agent_space and engine, copied unchanged except the session's run id
vendored.leftOut: the benchmark rows (they belong to the brain benchmark lab) and the session's run id (run ids are never published)

rule: every figure carries its source; nothing without one is published

agent_space.note: latency = the visitor's line to the agent's proof record, wall time, one machine (Windows + WSL2); it INCLUDES the scripted visitor's measuring overhead (0.25 s polling + a fixed 0.6 s wait for multi-line answers), so the true answer time is about 0.6-0.85 s lower; the agents: Odin (concierge, world + rules), Atlas (knowledge base), Juno (support notes), Pulse (an external HTTP agent)

engine.what: a fine-tuned 1.5B model (~1 GB) against the larger v3 stack, on 280 seeded agent tasks
model calls per successful task, before and after the v3 router (rules for mechanics, model for language)
seeded replays of a recorded run
agents as QA: a real outage found and its fix confirmed; reachable places
1,000 moving and talking agents in one campus: server time per tick at 10 Hz
engine.unit: ms per tick (LANE, not on main)

engine.what: the campus scene's draw calls and frame time, instanced art + text LOD against placeholders
